userStories.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding
userStories.notes: CRITICAL [src/commands/setup.ts:54]: US-001 AC1 named-command oracle `grep -q "'linear' | 'github' | 'local'" src/commands/setup.ts` FAILS at Layer B (exit 1).
